name: Tapped-secondary current transformer
summary: A tapped CT secondary provides alternative documented transformation ratios through different terminal combinations.
description: A tapped CT secondary provides alternative documented transformation ratios through different terminal combinations. The schematic must identify the selected tap and the treatment of unused terminals.
readingNotes: Determine the operational ratio from the connected tap pair rather than from the full nameplate range.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A tapped winding selects a ratio; it does not create two independently loaded measurement windings.
